kpis.definition: Distinct current DOHMH restaurant locations in the selected area.
kpis.explanation: 27,497 restaurant locations are currently in the data. Current snapshot means this is the latest total, not a change.

kpis.period: open at the latest complaint snapshot; compared with one week earlier
kpis.definition: Food Establishment and Food Poisoning complaints that had not yet closed.
kpis.explanation: 4,473 food-related 311 complaints were still open at the latest data snapshot. This is 6.5% more than one week earlier.

kpis.period: latest grade; compared with one month earlier
kpis.definition: Average score from each restaurant's latest graded inspection; lower is generally better.
kpis.explanation: The average inspection score is 11.4; lower is generally better. It is unchanged from one month earlier.

kpis.period: latest grade; compared with one month earlier
kpis.definition: Share of currently graded restaurants whose latest grade is A.
kpis.explanation: 89.8% of restaurants' latest grade is A. That is 0.5 percentage points higher than one month earlier.

kpis.period: calendar year through the latest inspection snapshot
kpis.definition: Distinct inspections whose DOHMH action closed or re-closed the establishment.
kpis.explanation: 588 temporary closures were recorded by DOHMH so far this year. 70 were recorded this month.

kpis.period: trailing year compared with the preceding year
kpis.definition: Inspections with at least one critical finding per 100 inspections.
kpis.explanation: In the past year, about 77 out of every 100 inspections found at least one serious food-safety violation. That is 0.3 more inspections per 100 than the previous year.
